title: Breaking the WAL
summary: This is a technical deep-dive from Antithesis investigating a bug in Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) systems, a critical database recovery mechanism. The article likely explores a subtle race condition or state corruption issue that breaks WAL's guarantees of data durability and crash recovery.
problem_solved: Diagnoses and demonstrates a bug that compromises the reliability guarantees of Write-Ahead Logging in database systems.
why_valuable: WAL is foundational to database reliability; finding and explaining such bugs helps the community understand edge cases in distributed database internals.
